reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "fix: failure on github deprecation use of status checks by @gusfcarvalho in https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pull/4640", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Environments that were hitting the failure caused by GitHub's deprecation of the use of status checks stop failing once upgraded to 0.16.0; the evidence states no operator action beyond upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade to 0.16.0; the evidence states no operator action beyond upgrading.

proposed.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 fixes a failure that occurred because GitHub deprecated the use of status checks.
